v949 hide selector now permits both the old v949 spinner and the current v1146 DOM spinner
dynamic spinner CSS includes an explicit visibility override for the current DOM spinner

rootCause: The current download code correctly inserted .azobss-btn-spinner-v1146, but the later v949 CSS rule hid every child of a busy .az-lot-format-download except .az-lot-busy-spinner-v949. Because generic PA/BM Download uses the v1146 DOM spinner, the spinner existed in the DOM but was display:none.
